description: Plant the data infrastructure for a future persona growth dashboard: a place where a user can see, visually, how their thinking has evolved and how Zug has been providing value over time. Phase 1 (this ticket): periodic PERSONA.md snapshots stored as diffs or versioned copies, plus a structured growth summary that captures: observation rate over time, ACTIVE pattern churn (patterns added/retired), session frequency trends, reinforcement counts on top patterns, and a weekly/monthly "what Zug learned about you" narrative digest. The data model should be dashboard-ready even if no UI exists yet. Phase 2 (future): a lightweight web dashboard (or email digest) that renders the growth data visually — pattern emergence timelines, session heatmaps, insight quality over time. The north star: a user opens the dashboard and can answer "what has Zug taught me about how I think?" and "is Zug getting better at working with me?"
title: Persona growth snapshots — infrastructure for insight into how Zug is providing value
